blocks.text: Fossil has always been inspired by American creativity and ingenuity. Since 1984, we've strived to bring new life into the industry by making quality, fashionable watches and accessories that were both fun and accessible. This Fossil watch women will love offers a stylish timepiece.

items.label: ICONIC
items.value: A true icon from our archives, the rectangular Raquel Fossil watch is updated for the current moment. Slim and versatile, it features a solid watch face with a glitz inner-frame, three-hand date movement and seven-link bracelet

items.label: CASE & MOVEMENT
items.value: 23mm case, 12mm band width, hardened mineral crystal lens resists scratches, accurate Quartz movement with 3-hand date analog watch display, imported.

items.label: DIAL
items.value: One of many among Fossil watches for women, this wristwatch features a rectangle gold stainless steel case, with a silver satin dial and gold accents

items.label: WRIST WATCH BAND
items.value: Gold, durable stainless steel bracelet band with a secure fold-over clasp closure; links can be removed for a customized fit; interchangeable with all Fossil 12mm watch straps

items.label: WATER RESISTANT WOMEN'S WATCHES
items.value: Up to 50m (165ft): Wearable for short periods of recreational swimming and showering, but not diving or snorkeling; 5 ATM
